validation_scale: Correctness fixture: 1000 main + 10 related; not a performance benchmark.

source_semantics.text: Empty CSV text becomes null; no non-null empty-string acquisition coverage.
source_semantics.checkbox: Omitted CSV checkbox uses false default; no nullable-boolean acquisition coverage.
source_semantics.datetime: This Bulk load path stores whole seconds; input milliseconds are explicit in enumerated input rows, not promised as stored values.
source_semantics.decimal: Exact numeric comparison; large 8-integer-digit .125 is representable; arbitrary decimal(18,10) maxima are not claimed to survive Salesforce numeric APIs.
source_semantics.paging: Scaled fixture requires test-requested REST batchSize=200 and Bulk maxRecords=100 to exercise real locators; default-page CLI acquisition is separately checked. Paging is evidence only after live execution.

note: Independent value oracle for the disposable-org Salesforce fixture. grvfix_values(i)/grvfixrel_values(i) in generate.py are the single source of truth for every value; enumerated_rows and aggregates are snapshots of that function. The org is disposable; provisioning a replacement org is described in README.md.

org.requirements: disposable org, Developer Edition or above (custom objects required); authorized in the local sf store as alias grv-fixture; the concrete identity (org id, url, api version) is recorded in manifest/provision-evidence.json at provisioning time

grvfix.note: GrvRel__c is empty in the generated file; provision.py resolves it to the loaded GrvFixRel__c Ids for i < 10 and records the resolved file hash in the run evidence.

fields.Name: text(80)
fields.GrvDateTime__c: datetime(UTC), nullable; CSV milliseconds explicitly expected to truncate to seconds
fields.GrvBool__c: checkbox, non-null; omitted CSV value defaults to false
fields.GrvFormula__c: formula text = TEXT(GrvInt__c or 'null') & ':' & IF(GrvBool__c = NULL, '?', IF(GrvBool__c, 'T', 'F'))

GrvText__c_classes.i%8==1: empty CSV text, stored as null

base.rest_page_note: Actual page sizes depend on selected fields/payload; traverse all nextRecordsUrl pages and verify count and unique Ids.
base.bulk: all rows across one or more result files; total must equal row_count with unique Ids

rel.note: dot-notation relationship sources GrvRel__r.*; rows with i >= 10 have null relationship values
